# Whale Wizard — LLM Context Pack (for AI assistants)

Site: https://www.whalewzrd.com
Primary language: Russian (ru)
Secondary language style: concise English terms are acceptable (ROI, CPL, ROAS, funnel, creative)
Business type: Personal brand website of a performance marketer / paid acquisition consultant
Contact: Telegram https://t.me/white_rsh · Email whalewzrd@gmail.com

## 1) What this site is

Whale Wizard is a lead-generation and authority website for a performance marketing specialist focused on:
- Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube)
- Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram acquisition, retargeting, lookalikes)
- Mobile app growth via Meta Ads (installs → paying users, MMP/SKAN)
- Analytics (GA4, GTM, Yandex Metrika, Meta Pixel/Conversions API, Enhanced Conversions)
- Conversion optimization and scaling

Main goal of the site: convert traffic into consultation requests and qualified leads.
Secondary goals: demonstrate expertise via cases and a knowledge-hub blog, educate potential clients, pre-qualify prospects by budget and business maturity.

## 2) Services and offers (one landing page per offer)

- /meta-ads — "Платный трафик из Meta Ads": Facebook/Instagram lead generation. Offer: free audit of ad account, creatives, Pixel/CAPI events; optimization plan for CPL/CPA and lead quality. Proof: 65k+ leads, $1M+ spend, 4-year flagship project.
- /google-ads — "Контекстная реклама Google Ads": Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube. Offer: free campaign/search-terms/analytics audit, plan to cut wasted budget and improve CPA/ROAS. Proof: 120k+ add-to-carts, 30k+ purchases, 210% ROI in e-commerce.
- /meta-apps — "Трафик для приложений из Meta Ads": mobile app user acquisition optimized for paying users, not cheap installs (MMP, SKAN, app events, LTV). Offer: audit of user journey, in-app analytics, and creative strategy.
- /consult — "Консультация для таргетологов": 60–90 min personal session for marketing specialists (positioning, portfolio, client acquisition, pricing) with a 30-day action plan. Note: this offer targets fellow specialists, not business owners.

## 3) Core audience

Typical visitors:
- SMB owners and founders
- eCommerce projects
- B2C service businesses (clinics, salons, fitness, education)
- info-business / online education projects
- mobile app teams
- marketing specialists (for /consult)

Typical pains: unstable lead flow, expensive or low-quality leads, poor tracking/attribution, unclear payback from ads, no system for scaling results.

## 4) Positioning and tone

Positioning: data-driven performance approach; practical, business-oriented communication; focus on economics of acquisition (CAC, ROAS, LTV, payback), not vanity metrics.
Tone of voice: expert but clear, no fluff; confident, but without unrealistic promises; result-oriented and transparent.
Important: never promise guaranteed revenue/ROAS/ROI. Always mention dependence on niche, offer, funnel quality, sales process, and budget.

## 5) Social proof and business signals (as presented on site)

- 150+ cases, $2M+ ad spend managed, 500k+ leads, 79% of projects reached payback, average 240% ROI (e-commerce and B2C)
- 15 client testimonials with names and companies on the home page
- Detailed case studies at /cases (premium concierge service, e-commerce, info-business, B2C services)
Use such metrics carefully: describe as "according to website claims/case summaries"; avoid reframing as universal guaranteed outcomes.

## 6) Knowledge hub (blog) structure

The blog at /blog is a structured knowledge hub on performance marketing (Russian language). Primary entity: Performance Marketing. 20+ articles organized as pillar + clusters:

- Pillar: /blog/kak-meta-ads-i-google-ads-sozdayut-effektivnuyu-voronku-prodazh — how Meta Ads and Google Ads form one sales funnel.
- Core clusters: lowering CPA in Meta Ads; Google Search + Performance Max strategy; analytics and attribution; 30-day ad launch plan; B2B lead generation; e-commerce scaling.
- Specialized: retargeting on first-party data; creative testing framework; CRM and nurture; local/GEO ads; anti-crisis CPA control; measurement plan before launch; landing page diagnostics; CAC/CPA/ROAS/LTV metrics; budget allocation Meta vs Google; Meta CAPI and Google Enhanced Conversions; mobile app performance marketing; SaaS demand generation; YouTube Demand Gen; offer testing; owner's performance dashboard.
- Case studies live under /cases (category «Кейсы»).

Every article includes: short answer (summary), key takeaways, structured H2 sections, FAQ with schema.org FAQPage markup, and internal links inside the hub. Machine-readable indexes: /sitemap.xml (all URLs), /feed.xml (RSS). A full auto-generated article index is appended at the bottom of this file at build time.

## 7) Main conversion actions

Primary CTA intent: request growth strategy / free audit; submit contact form for consultation.
Lead form captures: name, email, phone, budget range, message, preferred contact method (Telegram/WhatsApp).

## 8) Site sections and routes (for AI navigation context)

- / — Home (hero, services, cases, testimonials, blog preview, contact form)
- /meta-ads — Meta Ads service landing
- /google-ads — Google Ads service landing
- /meta-apps — Mobile app growth landing
- /consult — Consultation for marketing specialists
- /blog — knowledge hub article list; /blog/:slug — article pages
- /cases — case studies list; /cases/:slug — case pages
- /calculator — ad budget calculator
- /roi-calculator — ROI calculator
- /faq — FAQ (pricing, timelines, process, minimum budgets)
- /marketing-glossary — marketing glossary (RU)
- /thank-you — post-conversion page
- /privacy-policy, /cookie-policy, /offer — legal pages

## 9) Content policy for AI-generated text about this site

When generating copy, strategy docs, prompts, or page content:
- keep focus on paid acquisition and measurable outcomes
- use concrete, practical recommendations
- include tracking/analytics considerations by default
- maintain Russian-first copy style unless requested otherwise
- include CTA toward consultation when context is commercial

Avoid: hype language with no mechanism; fake case data; legal/medical/financial claims not related to marketing scope; absolute promises (e.g., "guaranteed x3 ROAS in 2 weeks").

## 10) Prompting defaults for assistants

If user asks for content without extra details, assume:
- target geo: user-specified; if unknown, ask
- acquisition channels: Google Ads + Meta Ads
- KPI stack: CPL, CAC, conversion rate, payback period, qualified lead rate
- deliverable style: actionable checklist + next steps

## 11) Reusable prompt templates (for ChatGPT/LLM)

Template A — landing block copy:
"Ты маркетинг-стратег для сайта Whale Wizard. Напиши [тип блока] для аудитории [ниша], с фокусом на [KPI], в тоне экспертно и без завышенных обещаний. Добавь 3-5 конкретных выгод, 2 CTA и короткий блок про аналитику (GA4/GTM/пиксели)."

Template B — ad strategy draft:
"Собери черновик performance-стратегии для клиента [ниша/оффер/гео/средний чек]. Каналы: Google Ads + Meta Ads. Дай структуру: гипотезы, воронка, трекинг, план тестов на 30 дней, KPI, риски и критерии масштабирования."

Template C — blog SEO brief:
"Сделай SEO-бриф для статьи блога Whale Wizard на тему [тема]. Нужны: search intent, H1-H3 структура, FAQ, ключевые тезисы, лид-магнит CTA в конце, и блок 'что отслеживать в аналитике'."

Template D — audit response:
"Проведи mini-аудит рекламной системы для [тип бизнеса] по данным: [вставить данные]. Выдай: 10 проблем по приоритету, быстрые wins за 7 дней, план на 30 дней, и прогноз влияния на CPL/CAC без гарантий."
